Historical v24 summary: the following text describes the unchanged inherited five-field linear-response checkpoint, published as record 22347452 (semantic version 2026.09.05-v24). It is retained for historical context. The main Description above describes the current source/operator update.

Historical v24 plain-language summary

This checkpoint completes an error-controlled calculation across the whole domain of a registered fixed-background five-field linear mathematical model. It joins 176 calculation regions with exactly matching boundaries, then includes bounds for the equation error, background uncertainty, boundary-data error and source integration. The resulting two-by-two response matrix has a determinant between 2.12278154373842557755059 and 2.53743323308364125340774. Because this interval is entirely positive, the two selected input pulses produce linearly independent output patterns in the two chosen mathematical readouts, within the model's stated assumptions.

The advance is a complete certification argument for this adjoint calculation over the full domain. Earlier project checkpoints already reported rank-two results by other arguments. This release does not claim a more precise determinant estimate or external mathematical novelty.

The conclusion depends on the archived background branch and inherited equations, source identities and stability bounds. A separate rigorous error enclosure for the independent forward calculation remains open. The detector normalizations are mathematical coefficient conventions; they do not establish physical measurement sensitivity or observational accessibility.

These results do not show that a higher-dimensional blast caused the Big Bang. Nonlinear persistence, agreement with cosmological observations and the proposed physical mechanism remain unestablished. The reviews and replays are internal checks, not external peer review or proof-assistant formalization.

NONSEALED PROSPECTIVE METADATA TEMPLATE. The real stored-state comparison is UNCOMPUTED. All new measured errors, numerical bounds, gate outcomes, result receipts and release pins are PENDING. This text records an intended additive mathematical-methods checkpoint, not a completed result or publication authorization.

The proposed next edition remains in main concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17088132. Its asset plan inherits all 27 files from record 23225288 without alteration and adds HDBLAST_CHECKPOINT_20261007_STORED_STATE_COMPARISON.zip and HDBLAST_STORED_STATE_COMPARISON_OVERVIEW_20261007.md, giving a planned 29-file inventory. The two additions, their bytes, sizes, MD5/SHA256 digests and the complete inherited-file verification are PENDING.

The registered problem is the difference between exact represented stored binary80 inputs and the unchanged prescribed Bunch–Davies prehistory target on the inherited fixed geometry. The prospective reader covers 20 arrays in four separately identified source/resolution capsules, with 49,152 capsule-node occurrences and 12 positional prefix cases. The new target construction uses an entire degree-832 representation, 512-bit Arb arithmetic and a complete exported target-rectangle L1-radius gate of 1e-18 at every node. These are fixed prospective design requirements; actual coverage, all comparison values and every gate outcome are PENDING.

The intended saved-minus-target analysis retains all real and imaginary U/W component differences, signed and absolute normalization discrepancies and the infrared-stable kA coordinate without projecting or renormalizing the stored state. Subsequent exact finite-weight transport concerns the difference under identical forcing and contacts. A bound on a finite weighted sum does not establish stored-state regularity between nodes, continuum interpolation, time or momentum quadrature, later numerical trajectory accuracy, full contacts or ultraviolet tails.

Original literature synthesis is bounded by 46 recorded verified-TLS GET requests returning HTTP 200 and eight retrieved primary PDFs read at selected passages. These are historical working-evidence observations, not an exhaustive literature search, independent scientific replication or a full-proof review. No third-party or private document bodies are included in the proposed additions. A prescribed effective source does not identify a higher-dimensional origin against an unconstrained four-dimensional source; a physical test requires a declared bulk/brane action, source and state, matching conditions, energy/flux normalization and restricted observable predictions.

The full twelve-case 2e-8 pressure/contact continuum certificate remains UNRESOLVED; metric calibration remains FAIL. Physical energy normalization, coupled gravity, heating, thermalization, a sustained radiation era, observational agreement and a higher-dimensional cause of the Big Bang remain NOT_ESTABLISHED. External novelty remains NOT_ASSESSED. Internal AI-assisted reviews are not external peer review or proof-assistant formalization. Companion record 23111008 in concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22922927 is untouched. Reports/data retain the inherited CC BY 4.0 rights, code its included MIT license, and third-party material its own license.
